title: Treaty of Windsor
summary: A secret Anglo-Portuguese declaration was signed in London on 14 October 1899 by Lord Salisbury and the Marquis of Soveral, and is called the Treaty of Windsor after the alliance of 1386 that it reaffirmed. Britain restated its guarantee of Portugal's colonies; Portugal undertook to close Lourenço Marques to arms and men bound for the Transvaal, days before the South African war began. It was signed a year after Britain and Germany had secretly agreed how they would divide those same colonies if Portugal defaulted on its debts, which is what makes the declaration a purchase as much as a guarantee. It is in the atlas as the last renewal of the alliance before the alliance was called on, in 1914.
